<thought>The most intense ion is at m/z 182.0732. The M+1 peak intensity (~14 %) corresponds to about 13 carbons (13 × 1.1 % ≈ 14 %). A formula with 13 carbons that matches the exact mass is C₁₃H₁₀O (monoisotopic mass = 182.073165 Da), which fits the observed m/z without needing an added proton. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C13H10O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H10O</final_answer>
